subject.title: feat(macos): onboarding mascot reacts with moods, randomized idle behavior, and Easter eggs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the full mood, randomized idle, auto-sleep, and Easter-egg behavior across macOS onboarding and About plus the selected iOS hero marks?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but this protected feature changes passive branding into persistent randomized product interaction across several native surfaces, which requires explicit product ownership.

options.title: Adopt the full interaction set
options.body: Approve all proposed moods and Easter eggs across the selected native surfaces, subject to exact-head validation and native behavior confirmation.

options.title: Limit to onboarding moods
options.body: Keep state-driven onboarding expressions but defer randomized idle and Easter-egg interactions outside onboarding.

options.title: Retain the current mascot
options.body: Decline the expanded interaction model and keep the existing fixed animation loop.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full interaction set
recommendation.body: Approve all proposed moods and Easter eggs across the selected native surfaces, subject to exact-head validation and native behavior confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: Live merged history shows this person introduced and recently maintained the shared mascot and its macOS integration.
